name: embarch-ui-launcher
description: Thin launcher for embarch-ui: starts/stops the server as a subprocess and opens it in the system browser. Renders nothing inside the editor.

embarchUi.binaryPath.description: Path to the embarch-ui binary. Defaults to 'embarch-ui' on PATH — set an absolute path if it isn't installed there.

embarchUi.host.description: Host embarch-ui binds to. Must match embarch-ui's own BIND_ADDR (127.0.0.1 by default, loopback-only).

embarchUi.port.description: Port embarch-ui binds to. Must match embarch-ui's own BIND_PORT.

embarchUi.configPath.description: Optional path to an embarch-ui TOML config file. Sets EMBARCH_UI_CONFIG for the spawned process; left empty, embarch-ui's own zero-config defaults apply.

embarchUi.autoStart.description: Start embarch-ui automatically when VS Code starts (and stop it when VS Code closes).
